reason: A DSH Web interface plugin that adds an interactive floating whale pet and synchronizes its speech and animations with agent tool calls and conversation lifecycle events.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 页面添加可交互的浮动蓝鲸桌宠，并通过模型工具调用和对话起止事件同步说话与动画状态。
summaries.en: Adds an interactive floating blue whale pet to DSH Web and synchronizes its speech and animations with agent tool calls and conversation lifecycle events.

capabilities: Adds a floating interactive whale pet to the DSH Web interface
Registers a pet_say agent tool that displays model-provided text in the pet UI
Listens for root conversation start and end events to change the pet state
Streams host-side pet events to the browser through an SSE endpoint
Supports user interactions including dragging, clicking, double-clicking, long-pressing, hovering, and context-menu actions
